crossRefs.note: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.
Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

that you shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field. You shall be made to eat…
At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me, and I…
However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

translations.web: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
translations.bsb: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
translations.kjv: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
translations.asv: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High. Psalm 8 For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of David.
